source_review.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists and cardiovascular outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
source_review.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

conclusion_summary: GLP-1 agonists demonstrate robust cardiovascular benefit including weight loss, reduced MACE events, and improved glycemic control.
limitations: GI side effects leading to discontinuation in ~10-15%

quantitative_claims.claim: 20% reduction in MACE events with semaglutide
